name: CoPart
desc:
BluCar - Call For Release CSR | $16.04 - $22.00/hr | Phone and Email Heavy, Vehicle Release Coordination
Company: Copart, Inc. (BluCar division)
Industry: Automotive | Online Vehicle Auction & Logistics
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Copart is a global online vehicle auction platform, and this role has you working within their BluCar division, coordinating vehicle releases between body shops, impound facilities, lien holders, rental companies, and fleet operators. Essentially, when a vehicle needs to be released for pickup and transport, you're the one making the calls and sending the emails to get all parties to sign off and coordinate timing.
You'll be managing a high volume of outbound and inbound communication, tracking everything through system updates and documentation, and working to hit specific KPIs tied to calls made, release percentages, and turnaround time. Because this role touches multiple stakeholders (body shops, impound lots, insurance-adjacent lien holders), problem-solving and clear communication matter as much as raw call volume, you're troubleshooting real obstacles that delay a release and keeping everyone updated along the way.
assessment: Yes. Copart frequently uses typing, attention-to-detail, administrative aptitude, and customer service assessments during hiring.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma.
 Required Experience: 1 year of office support experience in a customer service role and/or call center preferred, not strictly required.
 Preferred Experience: Bilingual skills a plus.
 Required Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication
Typing speed of 45 WPM
Proficiency in MS Office Suite and general office equipment
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
Professional appearance
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone comfortable with a high-volume mix of phone and email communication tracked against daily/weekly KPIs
Participants who enjoy problem-solving and coordinating between multiple parties to resolve a logistical holdup
Anyone with prior office/call center experience, though not strictly required
People with strong typing speed (45 WPM) and attention to detail for accurate documentation
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need a lower call/communication volume role
Someone who struggles with juggling multiple stakeholders and systems simultaneously
Anyone unable to work occasional overtime based on business needs
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
Vehicle release coordination
Call center
Multi-stakeholder communication
KPI performance
Documentation accuracy
Problem resolution
Office support
Automotive industry
High-volume communication
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you.
If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen.
If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview.
 Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you had to coordinate between multiple parties to resolve a logistical delay.
How do you stay accurate and detailed while managing a high volume of calls and emails?
Describe your typing speed and comfort with data entry under time pressure.
How do you handle a situation where a release is delayed and you need to communicate that to several stakeholders at once?
What does meeting daily and weekly KPIs look like for you in a fast-paced role?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $16.04-$22.00/hr. For California, Colorado, New York, and Washington specifically, the range is $18.00-$24.00/hr.
Shift: Full-time, remote. Overtime related to business needs.
Benefits: Medical/dental/vision, 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), no-cost Employee Assistance Program, vacation and sick pay, paid company holidays, life and AD&D insurance, employee discounts.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research specific to Copart/BluCar.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting. Copart does participate in E-Verify for employment eligibility confirmation.
Notes: This is a real, active vacancy accepting applications on an ongoing basis. Copart is a large, publicly traded company (S&P 500) with a strong global presence, worth highlighting for stability. Related roles at Copart, like Title Express Processor, show similar entry-level, no-degree-required administrative positions in the automotive/insurance-adjacent space, worth checking if this specific posting isn't a fit.
Career Pathway: BluCar CFR CSR → Senior CFR CSR → Team Lead → CFR Operations Supervisor → CFR Operations Manager
